title: Generate a context: the zod contracts, the BFF and the surface

name.x-prompt: What is the context called (e.g. model-catalog)?

directory.description: Context root that holds contract/, bff/ and web/. Defaults to apps/<name>.

title.description: Document title in index.html. Defaults to the context name.

bffPort.description: Port the BFF serves on. The surface proxies /trpc and /api to it.

webPort.description: Port the surface dev server and preview server listen on.

skipFormat.description: Skip running prettier over the generated files.

skipPackageJson.description: Skip the package install that links the new workspace packages.

skipCi.description: Do not write .gitlab/ci/contexts/<name>.yml or register it in .gitlab-ci.yml.
